definition: a road vehicle with four wheels and an engine
exampleSentence: My parents have a small red car.
exampleTranslation: Bố mẹ tôi có một chiếc ô tô nhỏ màu đỏ.

definition: a large vehicle that people pay to travel on
exampleSentence: I go to school by bus.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi học bằng xe buýt.

definition: a long vehicle on a railway that carries people or goods
exampleSentence: The train to Hanoi leaves at nine.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến tàu đi Hà Nội khởi hành lúc chín giờ.

definition: a vehicle that flies in the air and has wings and engines
exampleSentence: The plane landed ten minutes late.
exampleTranslation: Máy bay hạ cánh trễ mười phút.

definition: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine
exampleSentence: The last passengers got on the aeroplane.
exampleTranslation: Những hành khách cuối cùng đã lên máy bay.

definition: an aircraft with metal blades on top that turn to make it fly
translation: máy bay trực thăng, trực thăng
exampleSentence: A helicopter flew over the city.
exampleTranslation: Một chiếc trực thăng bay qua thành phố.

definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals with your feet
exampleSentence: Can you ride a bicycle?
exampleTranslation: Bạn có biết đi xe đạp không?

definition: a bicycle, or a motorcycle
exampleSentence: I usually go to work by bike.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thường đi làm bằng xe đạp.

definition: a small fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
exampleSentence: Many people in Vietnam ride a motorbike.
exampleTranslation: Nhiều người ở Việt Nam đi xe máy.

definition: a fast two-wheeled vehicle with an engine
exampleSentence: My uncle rides a big motorcycle to work.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi đi làm bằng một chiếc xe mô tô lớn.

definition: a small, less powerful motorcycle with small wheels
exampleSentence: They bought a scooter to get around town.
exampleTranslation: Họ mua một chiếc xe tay ga để đi lại trong thành phố.

definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
exampleSentence: Let us take a taxi to the airport.
exampleTranslation: Chúng ta đi taxi ra sân bay nhé.

definition: a large road vehicle used to carry goods
exampleSentence: A truck is blocking the road.
exampleTranslation: Một chiếc xe tải đang chắn đường.

definition: a large vehicle for carrying heavy goods
exampleSentence: A big lorry stopped in front of us.
exampleTranslation: Một chiếc xe tải lớn dừng lại trước mặt chúng tôi.

definition: a vehicle smaller than a truck, used for carrying goods
exampleSentence: The shop uses a van for deliveries.
exampleTranslation: Cửa hàng dùng một chiếc xe tải nhỏ để giao hàng.

definition: a vehicle that takes ill or injured people to hospital
exampleSentence: Someone called an ambulance.
exampleTranslation: Có người đã gọi xe cứu thương.

definition: a large vehicle that carries equipment and people to stop fires
exampleSentence: A fire engine arrived in five minutes.
exampleTranslation: Xe cứu hỏa đã đến sau năm phút.

definition: a bus with comfortable seats used for long journeys
translation: xe khách, xe buýt đường dài
exampleSentence: We went to Da Lat by coach.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi Đà Lạt bằng xe khách.

definition: a passenger vehicle that travels along metal tracks in the street
exampleSentence: The tram stops outside the museum.
exampleTranslation: Xe điện dừng ngay trước bảo tàng.

definition: a railway system that runs under the ground below a big city
exampleSentence: I take the subway to work every day.
exampleTranslation: Ngày nào tôi cũng đi tàu điện ngầm đến chỗ làm.

definition: a railway system under the ground in a city
exampleSentence: The underground is the fastest way to get around London.
exampleTranslation: Tàu điện ngầm là cách nhanh nhất để đi lại ở London.

definition: a railway system that runs under the ground below a city
exampleSentence: We took the metro to the city centre.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi tàu metro vào trung tâm thành phố.

definition: a vehicle that travels across water
exampleSentence: We crossed the river by boat.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi qua sông bằng thuyền.

definition: a large boat used for carrying people or goods across the sea
exampleSentence: The ship leaves the port at noon.
exampleTranslation: Con tàu rời cảng lúc trưa.

definition: a boat that carries people or vehicles across a river or narrow sea
exampleSentence: We took the ferry to the island.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi phà ra đảo.

definition: a person who travels in a vehicle but does not drive it
exampleSentence: All the passengers got off the bus.
exampleTranslation: Tất cả hành khách đã xuống xe buýt.

definition: a person who rides a bicycle
exampleSentence: The cyclist stopped at the red light.
exampleTranslation: Người đi xe đạp dừng lại ở đèn đỏ.

definition: a person who is walking, especially in a street
exampleSentence: Pedestrians must wait for the green light.
exampleTranslation: Người đi bộ phải đợi đèn xanh.

definition: a hard surface for cars, buses, and bicycles to travel on
exampleSentence: Be careful when you cross the road.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cẩn thận khi băng qua đường.

definition: a public road in a town with houses or shops on its sides
exampleSentence: There are many shops on this street.
exampleTranslation: Có nhiều cửa hàng trên con đường này.

definition: a path at the side of a road for people to walk on
exampleSentence: Please walk on the pavement.
exampleTranslation: Xin hãy đi trên vỉa hè.

definition: a path at the side of a street for people to walk on
exampleSentence: Children were playing on the sidewalk.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đang chơi trên vỉa hè.

definition: one of the parts of a road marked by painted lines
exampleSentence: Cars must stay in their lane.
exampleTranslation: Ô tô phải đi đúng làn đường của mình.

definition: a part of a road that only bicycles can use
translation: làn đường dành cho xe đạp
exampleSentence: Cars cannot park in the cycle lane.
exampleTranslation: Ô tô không được đỗ trong làn đường dành cho xe đạp.

definition: a very wide road for fast travel over long distances
exampleSentence: We drove along the motorway for two hours.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi chạy xe trên đường cao tốc suốt hai tiếng.

definition: a wide main road that joins one town to another
exampleSentence: The highway goes from the city to the coast.
exampleTranslation: Con quốc lộ này nối thành phố với bờ biển.

definition: the point where two roads meet
exampleSentence: The shop is on the corner of this street.
exampleTranslation: Cửa hàng nằm ở góc đường này.

definition: a place where two roads meet and cross
exampleSentence: Turn left at the next crossroads.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ trái ở ngã tư tiếp theo.

definition: a place where one road joins another
exampleSentence: Turn right at the junction.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ phải ở ngã ba.

definition: a circular area where roads meet and cars drive around
exampleSentence: Take the second exit at the roundabout.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đi theo lối ra thứ hai ở vòng xuyến.

definition: a curved part of a road
exampleSentence: The car came round the bend too fast.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe vào khúc cua quá nhanh.

definition: a structure over a river or road that lets people cross
exampleSentence: We walked across the old bridge.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đi bộ qua cây cầu cũ.

definition: a passage under the ground or a mountain for cars or trains
exampleSentence: The train goes through a long tunnel.
exampleTranslation: Tàu đi qua một đường hầm dài.

definition: a set of red, yellow, and green lights that control traffic
translation: đèn giao thông, đèn xanh đèn đỏ
exampleSentence: Stop when the traffic light is red.
exampleTranslation: Hãy dừng lại khi đèn giao thông màu đỏ.

definition: a place marked with black and white lines where people can cross a road
translation: vạch qua đường, vạch kẻ đường cho người đi bộ
exampleSentence: Cars stop at the zebra crossing.
exampleTranslation: Xe dừng lại ở vạch qua đường.

definition: a sign at the side of a road showing directions and distances
translation: biển chỉ đường, cột chỉ đường
exampleSentence: The signpost says ten kilometres to the beach.
exampleTranslation: Biển chỉ đường ghi còn mười ki-lô-mét nữa là đến bãi biển.

definition: a sign next to a road that gives information to drivers
exampleSentence: Read the road sign before you turn.
exampleTranslation: Hãy đọc biển báo giao thông trước khi rẽ.

definition: the fastest speed allowed by law on a road
translation: giới hạn tốc độ, tốc độ tối đa
exampleSentence: The speed limit here is fifty kilometres an hour.
exampleTranslation: Tốc độ tối đa ở đây là năm mươi ki-lô-mét một giờ.

definition: the vehicles moving along a road or street
exampleSentence: There is a lot of traffic in the morning.
exampleTranslation: Buổi sáng có rất nhiều xe cộ.

definition: a long line of vehicles that cannot move or move very slowly
exampleSentence: We were stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi bị kẹt xe cả tiếng đồng hồ.

definition: the time of day when roads and buses are most crowded
exampleSentence: I try not to travel at rush hour.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cố gắng không đi lại vào giờ cao điểm.

definition: a space where you can leave a car or other vehicle
translation: chỗ đỗ xe, chỗ đậu xe
exampleSentence: There is free parking behind the hotel.
exampleTranslation: Có chỗ đỗ xe miễn phí phía sau khách sạn.

definition: an area where people can park their cars
translation: bãi đỗ xe, bãi đậu xe
exampleSentence: I left my car in the car park.
exampleTranslation: Tôi để xe trong bãi đỗ xe.

definition: a liquid fuel used in the engines of cars
exampleSentence: The car needs more petrol.
exampleTranslation: Xe cần đổ thêm xăng.

definition: a place where you buy petrol for your car
exampleSentence: There is a petrol station near the bridge.
exampleTranslation: Có một trạm xăng gần cây cầu.

definition: a place where you can buy petrol for motor vehicles
exampleSentence: Is there a gas station near here?
exampleTranslation: Gần đây có trạm xăng nào không?

definition: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers
exampleSentence: The station is five minutes from here.
exampleTranslation: Nhà ga cách đây năm phút.

definition: a place at the side of a road where buses stop for passengers
translation: trạm xe buýt, điểm dừng xe buýt
exampleSentence: I wait for the bus at the bus stop.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đợi xe buýt ở trạm xe buýt.

definition: the raised place beside a track where you get on a train
exampleSentence: The train to Hue leaves from platform six.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến tàu đi Huế khởi hành từ sân ga số sáu.

definition: a place where planes take off and land, with buildings for passengers
exampleSentence: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đến sân bay sớm hai tiếng.

definition: a system of tracks along which trains run
exampleSentence: The railway goes through the mountains.
exampleTranslation: Đường sắt chạy xuyên qua vùng núi.

definition: the part of a vehicle that makes it move
exampleSentence: The engine will not start.
exampleTranslation: Động cơ không nổ máy được.

definition: one of the round parts under a car or bicycle that turns
exampleSentence: The front wheel of my bike is flat.
exampleTranslation: Bánh trước xe đạp của tôi bị xẹp.

definition: a thick rubber ring around the wheel of a car or bicycle
exampleSentence: I have a flat tyre.
exampleTranslation: Xe tôi bị xẹp lốp.

definition: the wheel you turn to control the direction of a car
exampleSentence: Keep both hands on the steering wheel.
exampleTranslation: Hãy giữ cả hai tay trên vô lăng.

definition: a belt in a car that you fasten around yourself for safety
exampleSentence: Please fasten your seat belt.
exampleTranslation: Vui lòng thắt dây an toàn.

definition: a piece of equipment that makes a vehicle slow down or stop
exampleSentence: My bike has a problem with the brake.
exampleTranslation: Xe đạp của tôi bị hỏng phanh.

definition: one of the large lights at the front of a vehicle
exampleSentence: Turn on your headlights at night.
exampleTranslation: Hãy bật đèn pha khi đi vào ban đêm.

definition: the large window at the front of a car
translation: kính chắn gió, kính trước xe
exampleSentence: Rain was running down the windscreen.
exampleTranslation: Nước mưa chảy xuống kính chắn gió.

definition: a place where you can sit, especially in a vehicle
exampleSentence: Is this seat free?
exampleTranslation: Chỗ ngồi này còn trống không?

definition: one of the parts of a train where passengers sit
exampleSentence: Our seats are in the last carriage.
exampleTranslation: Ghế của chúng tôi ở toa cuối cùng.

definition: a piece of paper that shows you have paid to travel
exampleSentence: I bought a train ticket online.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đã mua vé tàu trên mạng.

definition: the money you pay to travel by bus, train, or plane
exampleSentence: The bus fare is very cheap.
exampleTranslation: Giá vé xe buýt rất rẻ.

definition: an official document that proves who you are when you travel abroad
exampleSentence: Do not forget your passport.
exampleTranslation: Đừng quên hộ chiếu của bạn.

definition: an official mark in your passport that lets you enter a country
exampleSentence: You need a visa to visit that country.
exampleTranslation: Bạn cần có visa để đến đất nước đó.

definition: the bags and cases you carry when you travel
exampleSentence: I only have one piece of luggage.
exampleTranslation: Tôi chỉ có một món hành lý.

definition: an official card that says you are allowed to drive
translation: bằng lái xe, giấy phép lái xe
exampleSentence: I do not have a driving licence yet.
exampleTranslation: Tôi vẫn chưa có bằng lái xe.

definition: a journey by plane
exampleSentence: Our flight to Tokyo takes six hours.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến bay đi Tokyo của chúng tôi kéo dài sáu tiếng.

definition: an occasion when you travel from one place to another
exampleSentence: The journey to the coast takes three hours.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến đi ra bờ biển mất ba tiếng.

definition: a visit to a place and back, for pleasure or for a reason
exampleSentence: We are planning a trip to Hoi An.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đang lên kế hoạch cho một chuyến đi Hội An.

definition: a way from one place to another
exampleSentence: What is the best route to the airport?
exampleTranslation: Đường nào đi ra sân bay là tốt nhất?

definition: how fast something moves or travels
exampleSentence: The truck was travelling at high speed.
exampleTranslation: Chiếc xe tải đang chạy với tốc độ cao.

definition: the way something moves or faces
exampleSentence: Which direction did the bus go?
exampleTranslation: Xe buýt đã đi theo hướng nào?

definition: when something happens later than it should
translation: sự chậm trễ, sự trễ chuyến
exampleSentence: There is a delay of twenty minutes.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến này bị trễ hai mươi phút.

definition: the act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey
translation: sự khởi hành, giờ khởi hành
exampleSentence: The departure time is ten past nine.
exampleTranslation: Giờ khởi hành là chín giờ mười.

definition: when someone or something arrives somewhere
exampleSentence: Our arrival was delayed by the rain.
exampleTranslation: Chuyến đến của chúng tôi bị chậm vì mưa.

definition: a line of people or vehicles waiting for something
translation: hàng người xếp hàng, hàng chờ
exampleSentence: There was a long queue at the bus stop.
exampleTranslation: Có một hàng dài người xếp hàng ở trạm xe buýt.

definition: to go from one place to another, especially far away
translation: đi du lịch, đi lại, di chuyển
exampleSentence: I like to travel by train.
exampleTranslation: Tôi thích đi bằng tàu hỏa.

definition: to control a car or other vehicle so that it moves
exampleSentence: My mother drives to work every day.
exampleTranslation: Mẹ tôi lái xe đi làm mỗi ngày.

definition: to travel on a bicycle or motorbike, or in a vehicle
exampleSentence: I ride my bike to school.
exampleTranslation: Tôi đi xe đạp đến trường.

definition: to leave a car in a place for a time
exampleSentence: You cannot park here.
exampleTranslation: Bạn không được đỗ xe ở đây.

definition: to not move or travel any more
exampleSentence: The bus stops outside my house.
exampleTranslation: Xe buýt dừng ngay trước nhà tôi.

definition: to go in a new direction when walking or driving
exampleSentence: Turn left at the traffic light.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ trái ở chỗ đèn giao thông.

definition: to go from one side of a road or river to the other
exampleSentence: Look both ways before you cross the road.
exampleTranslation: Hãy nhìn cả hai bên trước khi băng qua đường.

definition: to travel on water in a boat or ship
exampleSentence: We sail across the bay every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào chúng tôi cũng đi thuyền qua vịnh.

definition: to get to the place you are going to
exampleSentence: We arrived at the station at noon.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi đến ga lúc trưa.

definition: to go away from a place
exampleSentence: The train leaves at half past six.
exampleTranslation: Tàu khởi hành lúc sáu giờ rưỡi.

definition: to go or come back to a place
exampleSentence: We return to Hanoi on Sunday.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi trở về Hà Nội vào Chủ nhật.

definition: towards the left side
exampleSentence: Turn left at the corner.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ trái ở góc đường.

definition: towards the right side
exampleSentence: Turn right at the crossroads.
exampleTranslation: Hãy rẽ phải ở ngã tư.

definition: a long distance away
exampleSentence: Is the station far from here?
exampleTranslation: Nhà ga có xa đây không?

definition: only a short distance from a person or thing
exampleSentence: We live near the station.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi sống gần nhà ga.

definition: too full of people
exampleSentence: The bus was very crowded this morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nay xe buýt rất đông người.
